acip: DANG PO NI, KHYOD THA DAD KYANG YIN, KHYOD YIN PA MI SRID PA YANG YIN PA'I GZHI MTHUN DU DMIGS PA DE, RANG NYID 'GAL BA YIN PA'I MTSAN NYID,
wylie: dang po ni, khyod tha dad kyang yin, khyod yin pa mi srid pa yang yin pa'i gzhi mthun du dmigs pa de, rang nyid 'gal ba yin pa'i mtshan nyid
english: Here is the definition of what it is for two things to be in contradiction: The two things must (1) be distinct from each other, and then they must be such that (2) it is impossible for any one thing to be both of them.
